order_warnings: rule nesc_full_name: branches 1 and 2 are order-dependent (shared first bytes; ordered choice is decisive)
rule nesc_name: branches 1 and 2 are order-dependent (shared first bytes; ordered choice is decisive)
rule nesc_identifier: branches 4 and 5 are order-dependent (shared first bytes; ordered choice is decisive)

tests.input: Preprint Proposal for the 2017 Edition of the National Electrical Safety Code
Preprint Proposals for the 2022 Edition of the National Electrical Safety Code (NESC(R))

source:
# Port of lib/pubid/ieee/nesc/parser.rb — National Electrical Safety
# Code designations: C2-year, year-first, name-first and Draft forms
# with (R) marks, editions and variants. Consumed by the ieee grammar
# via `use nesc`.

grammar PubidNesc version "0.1.0" {
  digit = %x30-39
  digits = 1*digit
  space = " "
  comma = ","
  dash = "-"
  dot = "."
  slash = "/"

  year = 4digit
  c2_code = "C2" as code
  nesc_full_name = "National Electrical Safety Code" / "National Electric Safety Code"
  nesc_abbr = "NESC"
  nesc_name = nesc_full_name / nesc_abbr
  registered = "(R)"
  edition = ("Premier Edition" / "Second Edition" / "Third Edition" / "Fourth Edition" / "Fifth Edition" / "Sixth Edition" / "Seventh Edition" / "Eighth Edition" / "Ninth Edition" / "Tenth Edition" / "First Edition") as edition
  variant = ("Handbook" / "Redline") as variant
  month = ("January" / "February" / "March" / "April" / "May" / "June" / "July" / "August" / "September" / "October" / "November" / "December") as month

  c2_standard = (c2_code dash (year) as year [([comma] space)] nesc_full_name [registered] [(space "(" nesc_abbr [registered] ")")])
  year_first = ((year) as year) space (((nesc_full_name) as full_name [(registered) as name_registered] [(space "(" (nesc_abbr) as paren_abbr [(registered) as paren_registered] ")")]) / (((nesc_abbr) as abbr [(registered) as abbr_registered]))) [(space variant)] [(comma space edition)]
  name_first = ((nesc_full_name [registered]) comma space c2_code dash (year) as year [(space "-" space variant)])
  draft_nesc = (("Draft") as draft space nesc_name [registered] comma space (month) space (year) as year)
  # Preprint is a draft STAGE of the C2 code (NESC terminology for its
  # pre-edition drafts), not a variant: dotted is the canonical spelling
  # (C2.2012.Preprint); dash (C2-2012-Preprint) and the catalogue's
  # slash tail (C2-2002/Preprint) are aliases. The verbose
  # "Preprint Proposal(s) for the YYYY Edition of ..." forms cite the same
  # draft by its target edition year.
  c2_preprint = (c2_code ((dot (year) as year dot) / (dash (year) as year dash) / (dash (year) as year slash)) ("Preprint") as preprint)
  preprint_proposal = (("Preprint") as preprint space ("Proposals" / "Proposal") space "for" space "the" space (year) as year space "Edition" space "of" space "the" space nesc_full_name [(space "(" nesc_abbr [registered] ")")])
  nesc_identifier = draft_nesc / preprint_proposal / name_first / c2_preprint / c2_standard / year_first

  entry nesc_identifier: nesc_identifier

  test {
    accept "C2-2023 National Electrical Safety Code"
    accept "2023 NESC"
    accept "National Electrical Safety Code, C2-2017"
    accept "Draft NESC, January 2016"
    accept "C2.2012.Preprint"
    accept "C2-2012-Preprint"
    accept "C2-2002/Preprint"
    accept "Preprint Proposal for the 2017 Edition of the National Electrical Safety Code"
    accept "Preprint Proposals for the 2022 Edition of the National Electrical Safety Code (NESC(R))"
    reject "nonsense"
  }
}
